image_description: A close-up, slightly angled view of a vintage comic book cover. The cover features colorful, hand-drawn illustrations of superhero characters in action poses against a yellow building background. Bold, stylized red and white typography spells out the title at the top. Speech bubbles and caption boxes are visible within the panel layout. The paper appears to have a slight sheen, consistent with glossy comic stock. To the left, a portion of another comic spine is visible.

artifact_observations.reasoning: While the text mimics the *style* of comic book lettering, many of the characters are nonsensical or malformed upon close inspection (e.g., the main title letters are distorted and don't form clear standard English words, speech bubble text is largely illegible gibberish). This is a common AI artifact where the model captures the texture of text without the semantic structure.

Some facial features and hands exhibit slight smudging or lack of clear definition, blending into the background or other elements more than typical clean line art would. This suggests minor generation artifacts in fine details.
The windows and structural lines of the yellow building in the background are slightly warped and inconsistent in perspective, lacking the rigid geometric precision expected in drawn architecture.
